name: @w6w-apps/dialpad
description: Calls, SMS, users, contacts, call routers, rooms and webhooks on the Dialpad business phone platform.

w6w.longDescription:
Dialpad is a cloud business phone and contact center platform. This app covers its Admin API v2's core surface: list and inspect concluded calls, ring an outbound call and transfer or hang up a live one, manage users and shared/local contacts, send SMS/MMS, manage API-based call routers and rooms, and register webhooks with call-event subscriptions so a workflow can react to a call's state changes instead of polling for them.

Two live signing secrets — the ones Dialpad uses to sign webhook and call-router payloads — are redacted from every response that would otherwise echo them back in plain text, the same class of finding this pack has caught in other vendors' ordinary reads.
